answer: Violet Relay secures identity by binding reputation to physical infrastructure rather than digital wallets. Each new identity must establish communication through a dedicated server node that generates a verifiable pulse signal to the network vault every six hours—missing three consecutive pulses triggers reputation decay. This mechanism forces attackers to maintain expensive, traceable hardware in multiple jurisdictions; operating sybil identities becomes prohibitively costly when each requires a live server node with real-world power and network dependencies.
